[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Maximal rectangle** [LC 85 · Maximal Rectangle](https://leetcode.com/problems/maximal-rectangle/){difficulty="Hard"}

There is no "side from the three neighbours" for a rectangle. A staircase of ones has a large rectangle that is not the one growing out of the best neighbour. Fix the bottom row. The ones above each column are a histogram bar, and the largest rectangle in a histogram is the largest rectangle that uses that row as its floor. The square on this matrix is only $4$. The rectangle is $6$.

[Solved in full in @sec-gd-p5-rect.]{.card-link}
